description: Transcribe the timeline's speech with the local whisper.cpp. Without clipId it returns the timeline as sentences: each with its timeline start and end, the clip it starts in, its word indices fromIndex..toIndex and its text, one page of about 40 KB at a time. Pass nextFromSec as fromSec for the next page, or fromSec/toSec for a stretch of the timeline. Read it to pick a short's moments, then send whole sentences' indices to make_short. With clipId it returns that clip's words (view 'words'), each with its index and timeline time, plus phrases said twice in a row (retakes); view 'sentences' gives that clip's sentences instead. transcriptIds (by source; with more than one source each sentence names its mediaId) and transcriptId identify the transcript: send one back with an edit by index so it is refused, not misplaced, if the source was transcribed again. A word's `index` is stable for its source file. Optional feature: if whisper.cpp or a model isn't set up, the error says how. The first call per source file takes a while; later calls reuse the stored transcript.

clipId.description: Media clip to transcribe. Leave out for the whole timeline's sentences.

fromSec.description: Sentences starting at or after this timeline time (a page's nextFromSec).

language.description: Spoken language code, e.g. 'en'; 'auto' (the default) detects it.

timeline.description: Timeline to work on (default "main"). A short made with make_short is a timeline of its own.

toSec.description: Sentences starting before this timeline time.

view.description: words (default with a clipId) or sentences (default without one).

name: timeline_transcript
title: Transcribe the speech
